items.description: Battle through an onslaught of mystical backwater cultists, possessed militants & even darker forces as you attempt to discover just what lurks beneath the Earth in this retro FPS inspired by the '90s legends.
items.title: DUSK

items.description: A retro FPS for the ages! Once branded a HERETIC. Now YOU have been chosen as our champion! Reclaim our sacred weapons. Take back our ancient lands. If you can stand... AMID EVIL .
items.title: AMID EVIL

items.description: What you are about to do has not been approved by the Vatican. As a young priest, struggle against demons, cultists, and your own weakening faith in this pixel horror game inspired by the era of classic 8-bit gaming and the "Satanic Panic" of the 1980s.
items.title: Faith: The Unholy Trinity

items.description: The Black Labyrinth is an 'expansion pack' style prequel DLC for AMID EVIL, adding new levels/campaign content (not to be confused with the separate Black Labyrinth Official Soundtrack DLC).

items.description: The A.C.E.S. Once the watchful guardians of Switchblade City - are being taken down, one by one. Now it's up to one man, with two fists, to get to the bottom of it all. Fallen Aces is a crime noir FPS that plays right out of the '90s and looks like it's right outta the comics.
items.title: Fallen Aces

items.description: Weird west legends meet eldritch horror in BLOOD WEST , an immersive stealth FPS. Become the Undead Gunslinger, doomed to roam the barren lands until he manages to purge their curse, freeing his soul. 3 varied scenarios, perk-based character progression, and 20+ hours of gameplay await you!
items.title: Blood West

items.description: A new story chapter for the immersive stealth-action FPS where you play as The Shaman, paying a debt to the God of Death while wrangling lost souls with new weapons, skills, and eldritch horrors.
items.title: Blood West: Dead Man's Promise

items.description: ULTRAKILL is a fast-paced ultra-violent retro FPS that combines the skill-based style scoring of character action games with the unadulterated carnage inspired by the best shooters of the '90s. Rip apart your foes with varied destructive weaponry and shower in their blood to regain your health.
items.title: ULTRAKILL

items.description: Trapped in a dark, Victorian city consumed by an ancient curse, you must plan your survival and daring escape using nothing but stealth, an arsenal of eccentric weapons, and your wit in this haunting adventure inspired by the immersive sims and survival horror greats of the late 90s and early 2000s.
items.developer: Dillon Rogers, David Szymanski, Nate Berens, Thomas Porta
